## 01 · Inbox Triage
Every 5 minutes, new unread mail is sorted into one of five buckets (urgent, lead, billing, newsletter, other) and labelled in Gmail.

**Setup:** create 6 Gmail labels: one per bucket plus one named `triaged`. Paste each label ID into **Config**, including the `triaged` label's ID in LABEL_TRIAGED (Gmail > Settings > Labels, or run a Gmail 'Get many labels' node once). The trigger skips mail labelled `triaged`, so without it the same email gets sorted again on every run.

**Credentials:** open each node with a red warning and pick or create your own Gmail OAuth2, Google Sheets OAuth2 and OpenAI credentials. Nothing is hard-coded. Test with your own address before you activate.
